item: The dossier's corpus rails list their rows with how each joined (row 200)
summary: S08-01 S2's «each rail shows its own store's rows … evidence trails per item»: the news, Wikipedia and law rails carried a count only. Each now lists its newest joined articles (24 at most, newest first, undated last; the count stays the whole count and the rail says how many are not listed), each opening the local reader first (invariant #6) with its source, its date and the routes it joined by (a person or organisation named, a keyword, a place named): named, never weighed. Read-only, no new store; the rows ride in the signed export's manifest.dossier like every other rail row. 5 strings x12.
